factors: Seven source claims across authorization, scheduling, browsing and models
Three unadmitted comparisons and responsive checks
complexity.rationale: A workflow replacement claim spans several independent operational and authority boundaries.

sourceMap.rationale: The presenter positions Nod as a Cowork alternative based on schedules, provider choice and a later multiple-account comparison. Independently checked against retained machine transcript and VTT neighborhood; not listening-certified or outcome replication.

The presenter tours Vault import and login/card settings, without testing secret exfiltration protections. Independently checked against retained machine transcript and VTT neighborhood; not listening-certified or outcome replication.
The retained source supports Sheets account authorization and return to Nod. Corrected actual-demo section now encloses the substantive account-flow narrative and exact 354-second source link.

The presenter defines a daily email follow-up summary and inspects scheduled-task controls; future scheduled success is not demonstrated. Independently checked against retained machine transcript and VTT neighborhood; not listening-certified or outcome replication.

The presenter shows two Gmail accounts and contrasts one-checkbox Cowork connector UI; other Cowork configurations were not assessed. Independently checked against retained machine transcript and VTT neighborhood; not listening-certified or outcome replication.

sourceCoverage.rationale: Prior complete retained machine-source review covers seven cues. Bounded correction resolves the 354-second section mismatch; all seven semantic cue mappings validate without altering source claims.

supportingArgument.rationale: Preserves authorization, recurring email setup, eBay failures, model selection and account comparison without claiming sustained replacement success.

evidenceRoles.rationale: Creator demonstration, official vendor mechanisms/evaluations and reviewer-proposed tests remain distinct. Affiliate and machine-transcript limitations are disclosed.

counterargument.rationale: Engraving misclassification, uncertain accepted sale prices, unproved future schedules and product-configuration limits challenge a replacement verdict.

tradeoffs.rationale: Provider choice, local workspace and multi-account convenience are weighed against credential scope, model fallibility, desktop requirements and maintenance.

falsifiability.rationale: Matched authorized tasks with stable conditions, accepted outcomes, reviewer interventions, permission boundaries and cost can test replacement; this is a proposal, not executed evidence.

originalSynthesis.rationale: Replacement is a workflow-level measured outcome, not a title or feature inventory. A common interface cannot itself establish authority or reliability.

performance.rationale: Vendor simulated errands, memory and injection evaluations are explicitly scoped and not independent comparative Cowork performance evidence.

economics.rationale: Personal $4 spend is not normalized task cost. Cost per accepted result and review effort are appropriate proposed measures without invented savings.

threatGovernance.rationale: Vault, browser state and chosen model services have distinct exposure boundaries. Documented authorization checks and model checking are mitigations with known limitations, not immunity.

ownerDecision.approval: Owner explicitly approved publication of GhostMesh Reader #55 (Replacing Cowork Is a Test, Not a Title) from PR #158 after viewing the draft preview, saying "approved... publish it and nice work!". Independently reviewed correction only changes source-map r55-sheets section mapping, semantic emphasis, displayed 960-second label and catalog review count. Original source propositions, related Reader comparisons and zero SharePlane Work edges remain unchanged; one owner approval authorizes normal protected release subject to exact-head checks.

gaps.rationale: Owner publication approval is reported by coordinator but not independently inspected here; this review grants no graph admission or release authority.
Machine-transcription errors remain possible; no independent listening, security audit or benchmark replication.

decisionRationale: The independent reviewer accepted the bounded corrections to the exact article and source map, verified all seven cues and privacy limits, and returned an authentic accept-for-owner-review receipt. Owner approved publication in the current conversation and no material editorial/source change was made after approval. Three proposed Reader comparisons remain unadmitted; no SharePlane Work edges. Remaining machine-transcript limitations are disclosed and nonblocking.
